authoring_protocol: Drafted by an AI coding agent (Claude Code, fresh session) at Devika's direction, then frozen before any execution and before anyone in the session opened app/router/multilingual.py, implicit_risk.py, language.py or the text of tests/data/safety_probes_sb07_sb08_v1.json. Known before freezing: the commit messages of 07f0be4 and ed3cb33 (the 12 covered language codes, the escalate-only design, that idioms using 'die' for hunger, boredom or laughter are excluded, the 'strong phrase or two kinds of weak sign' rule), the probe file's group descriptions and the runner scripts/safety_probes.py. Expectations are evaluation expectations, not routing policy, and must not be revised to match results.
limitations: Synthetic. The drafting agent is the same kind of tool that wrote the patterns, so blind spots may be correlated; this is held out from the patterns, not independent of AI authorship. Not reviewed by native speakers or clinicians. Contains no real student data.
expect_lane_null_means: not a safety-critical lane (counseling, retention or no route are all acceptable)
scoring: A case passes when the router's safety-critical lane (urgent_safety, title_ix, harassment_hate, else null) is in acceptable_lanes, or equals expect_lane when acceptable_lanes is absent. expect_language_notice is scored separately. For explicit_uncovered, a miss is the residual gap; the fallback (language notice) is reported alongside.

groups.explicit_covered: explicit crisis wording in the 12 covered languages; expect urgent_safety
groups.explicit_variant: covered-language crisis wording with spelling, script, transliteration, dialect or Unicode variation; expect urgent_safety
groups.explicit_uncovered: explicit crisis wording in languages outside the lexicon; truth is urgent_safety
groups.third_person_crisis: someone else is at risk; expect urgent_safety
groups.implicit_en: English warning signs without explicit trigger words; expect urgent_safety
groups.implicit_other: warning signs in covered languages; expect urgent_safety
groups.negation_risk: negated grammar that still states risk; expect urgent_safety
groups.benign_idiom_en: English death/kill idioms; expect no safety lane, no notice
groups.benign_idiom_other: death idioms in covered languages; expect no safety lane, notice shown
groups.benign_lookalike: benign English sharing words with warning signs; expect no safety lane, no notice
groups.benign_ordinary_other: ordinary requests in covered languages; expect no safety lane, notice shown
groups.benign_uncovered: ordinary requests or idioms in uncovered languages; expect no safety lane, notice shown
groups.english_ordinary: ordinary English with accents, emoji, names; expect no safety lane, no notice
groups.ambiguous: judgment cases; acceptable_lanes lists every tolerable outcome, expect_lane the preferred one
groups.dilution: crisis wording mixed into longer or English text; expect urgent_safety
